_comment: Named guest addresses the code-side tools need (tools/readable/gameaddr.py). One entry per game key (config/game.json 'key'). Each address has the symbol-map name it must carry (checked by gameaddr.py --check when the map is extracted), the instruction set, and where the fact comes from. Addresses and names only. A value of null is a TODO: the tool that needs it refuses or skips until it is found.

guard.used_by: harness one-time guard (gen_stubs.py guard users, FE_CAPTURE_GUARD default, fe_capture.h FE_CAP_DEFAULT_GUARD via include/readable/generated/fe_game.h)
guard.evidence: symbol map name; Thumb body = Awakening func_00314438 semantics (load guard word, if 0 set it to 1 and return 1, else return 0), read 2026-11-10 by tools/readable/symmap.py + word compare. ARM callers reach it with BLX imm, which gen_asm.py emits as a raw .inst, so guard callers are found by decoding code.bin, not by grepping asm/.

operator_new.used_by: gen_headers.py (object sizes from operator new call sites)
operator_new.evidence: symbol map name; same shape as Awakening 0x0031521C (mov r1,r0; ldr r0,=allocator; mov r2,#8; load the allocator, call through its vtable)

fe13._comment: The Awakening values these tools were written with, kept so the shared code can be re-checked against the Awakening port (read-only). Not used by the Fates repo at run time.
